venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 10/14 (MOD MKZ/Jk, entered by Mya).** Net sales $1,633 vs target $1,510 (+8%). Food $332. 58 guests, $28.16 check avg. Comps $94.90. Third Wednesday trivia, seeing returning faces; smooth open. Team made an Eno Sbagliato mid-shift (Eno Amaro, Cocchi Vermouth di Torino, sparkling wine) - lean into local. Elijah Craig week winding down (old fashioned $1 under house, benefiting charity). Raven's last training day. Kitchen smooth. Low: Coke, tonic. Watch tajin usage. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 10/14 (MOD KK / Chef JMS, entered by BC).** Net sales $1,587 vs target $1,517 (+5%). Food $148. 54 guests, $29.38 check avg. Comps $53.30 (3.4%): trivia coupon, bingo credit, industry, resident. Steady Wednesday; biggest pop just after 7pm ahead of trivia (doubled net sales); 6 groups played, larger than recent weeks. Guests interested in pumpkin decorating on the 19th. 86: draft Guinness, Pumpkin Cream Ale. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Very cold, freeze warning; event kept in VH, garden unused
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 10/14 (AM MOD Momma Maggie / PM Uncle Maggie).** Net sales incl. events $17,612.15 vs target $9,151 (+92%). Base net $7,003.15 (DC/AM $968.66, D&C PM $6,034.49); event sales $10,609 (event food $5,186); total food incl. events $6,467.50 (base food $1,281.50). 166 guests (Tock). Comps $205. Two events: Baron App Inc. (30 guests, day 2 meetings, 9am-4pm Vauxhall) and US Bank evening event (expected 70, 30 attended). Steady night, 7pm biggest; second day in a row with a low-volume event. Freeze warning kept everyone inside. 86: matcha, sencha; low kombucha, cowboy coffee. Kitchen: light prep; low rabbit agnolotti, honey butter. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 10/14 (MOD & Chef Kyler & Steves).** Net sales $4,363 vs target $4,722 (-8%). Food $345, beverage $4,018. 123 guests, $36 check avg. Comps $38.20 (0.8%). About half full until 7:30pm, full until ~10:30pm with a waitlist of 2-tops; 9 guests inside by midnight. Maia's day 3 of server training. Many UK visitors. 2 no-shows (same phone number, different names). Menu count 16/16; breakage 1 SOF, 1 cheater bottle. No incidents or repairs.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 10/14 (MOD Marcus / Cory), private event (4pm workshop then reception; marquee + garden).** Net sales incl. events $19,604.40 vs target $3,079 (+537%); all sales were event sales; food $7,550. 106 guests (check avg derived: net/guests). Comps $0. Client arrived 2:30; light workshop attendance, garden full from ~5:30, marquee packed standing. Chicken biggest hit, then burrata; borrowed platters from City Tap House. Ran out of Lambrusco - raise par. Projector trouble likely client's laptop. Flag: service charges came in higher than on BEO invoice. Maintenance: curtain. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 10/14 (AM Franck & Lex / PM James & Drew).** Net sales $4,482 vs target $5,065 (-12%): Municipal AM $1,109, PM $3,373, Sun Club $233, Hot Eye $0. Food $1,851. 86 guests (OpenTable 12 AM + 74 PM), $52.12 check avg. Comps $246. Busy 5-6pm, then died off - room empty at 8pm, about a quarter full 9-10:30. Slow morning with a few food tours. Kitchen easy, no 86s. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: 61 and sunny; event prevented walk-ins until 9pm
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 10/14 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Reported net sales $2,376 vs target $8,000 (-70%), but this excludes a first paid event (event sales $5,710) that was not closed out in Toast (missing discounts/payment types/items); manager states total would have been $8,085.51 net (~+1% vs target). Food $489. 84 guests, $44.82 avg spend. Comps $104.80 (4.2%). Event party dropped from 35 to ~25; very positive reception. Slow re-set into regular service, then good vibes. Kitchen (Wes, Andrew) executed BEO prep. Event to be closed out 10/15 with correct payment options. Auto-Chlor fixed dishwasher pressure. No incidents.
